patches_removed.name: Fix third party launchers widgets
patches_removed.description: Allows the Spotify widgets to be added to third party launchers.

patches_removed.name: Use the Premium plan icon
patches_removed.description: Shows the bundled premium logo on the account/plan row instead of the white Spotify glyph. Label-only change; the account tier and entitlements are untouched.

patches_modified.name: Android Auto Up next
patches_modified.description: Publishes the player's real upcoming tracks to the media session on accounts whose peek-next restriction would otherwise hide the car's Up next list.

patches_modified.name: Android Auto support
patches_modified.description: Makes Spotify's car media browser, Home and Library work with DriveDeck, Gearslip or another compatible Android Auto host, including the bundled car service. Spotify's account, catalogue and playback services are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Block popup ads
patches_modified.description: Blocks fullscreen promotions ("Pendragon" messages) shown when opening the app.

patches_modified.name: Change package name
patches_modified.description: Changes the package name and app name so the patched app can be installed alongside the original Spotify app.

patches_modified.name: Disable ad breaks
patches_modified.description: Disables the ad slots that play ads between songs. Experimental.

patches_modified.name: Force play order
patches_modified.description: Sends shuffle=false in the app's SetShuffleState request so albums and playlists play in order. The native player may still apply a server restriction; shuffle-on is sacrificed while this patch is enabled.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the "Premium" tab from the bottom navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad sections
patches_modified.description: Removes brand ad sections from the home and search page.

patches_modified.name: Hide download buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the download button on tracks, albums, playlists and podcasts. Downloads, offline cache and account entitlements are unchanged; only the control is removed.

patches_modified.name: Hide playlist ads
patches_modified.description: Removes ads embedded into playlists.

patches_modified.name: Hide premium context-menu rows
patches_modified.description: Removes Download and Start a Jam (and the related premium-only Jam rows) from song, album and playlist context menus. Playback, library and sharing actions stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide premium settings sections
patches_modified.description: Removes Advertising, Download quality, Downloads and streaming, Offline, Storage and DJ sections from Settings. Playback, account, social and car settings stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide shuffle controls
patches_modified.description: Removes the shuffle and Smart Shuffle buttons. Spotify Free still enforces its shuffled queue, so the controls cannot hold an off state; playback, queue and library actions remain.

patches_modified.name: Hide video ads
patches_modified.description: Disables the video ad plugin of the now playing view.

patches_modified.name: Hide video shelves (safe)
patches_modified.description: Drops video/watch sections from Spotify's resolved Home feed, so video podcast and music-video shelves are not shown.

patches_modified.name: Remove shuffle restriction
patches_modified.description: Stops the Free 'Want to control how you listen?' upsell and lets the app use normal play order/shuffle controls. The account tier and server-side playback rules are unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking parameters (si, utm_source) from shared and copied links.

patches_modified.name: Show Premium in the account row
patches_modified.description: Displays Premium instead of Free account/Free plan on the account and plan rows. This is a label change only; the account tier and every entitlement stay unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Skip audio ads
patches_modified.description: Asks Spotify's own player to skip an audio ad through its media-session next command, and mutes the stream only when the player refuses. Enabling "Device broadcast status" in the Spotify settings improves the ad detection.

patches_modified.name: Remove subscription paywalls
patches_modified.description: Stops the startup plans page from blocking the app by treating the account as not waiting for payment and skipping the no-freemium startup redirect, stops the Premium tab and the startup Premium surface from blocking the app, redirecting the startup Premium activity to Home, and closes the artist paywall, trial-start and offer-dialog activities after their normal lifecycle starts. Account, sign-in and catalogue services are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Bot token sign-in
patches_added.description: Adds a Sign in with a bot token button to the phone number screen, so an account can sign in as a bot made with @BotFather. The bot sees a chat once someone messages it, without older history, contacts or stickers. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_added.name: Test server sign-in
patches_added.description: Shows Telegram's Test Backend box on the sign-in screen for every new account. Tick it to sign that account in on Telegram's test servers, kept apart from your other accounts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, where Receive only mode and Power off accounts also live, both off by default.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. patches_modified.name: Faster downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. A third, Faster uploads, keeps four times as many upload pieces in flight. A fourth, Download manager, runs downloads one at a time in the order you asked and adds a Downloads row to the side menu. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Startup diagnostics

Leave enabled while debugging a startup crash; it does not alter app behavior and never throws.

patches_modified.name: Ignore browser boot failures
patches_modified.description: Stops a failed engine boot (MainLibraryBoot) from deadlocking the welcome screen. patches_modified.name: Spoof app signature

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. The AMOLED dark mode switch in Hushfeed settings > App starts on, and turning it off brings TikTok's own dark grays back.

patches_modified.name: Accent color

Unread dots and counts change with it. Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. The feed's like heart and save bookmark can take colors of their own. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_modified.name: Comment tools

patches_added.description: Navigation's Default media app (Settings > Navigation) offers every music and podcast app that works with Android Auto, such as Poweramp, also where Google switches media controls off. YouTube Music and Spotify only connect to Google's own Maps.

patches_added.name: Avoid Flock cameras
patches_added.description: Steers driving directions around Flock cameras: when Google's route passes one, a camera-free way is worked out with BRouter, an OpenStreetMap router, and Maps asks Google again for a route through it, so Google still times and navigates the trip, and keeps it through reroutes. A detour longer than half again the distance is dropped. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, with Flock cameras; your route's start and end go to brouter.de. Trips with stops are left as they are.

patches_added.name: Better offline maps
patches_added.description: Reworks the offline area picker: zooming out really selects more instead of being shrunk to Google's size cap, the box can be resized by dragging its edges and corners, a large area is split into several downloads whose true total size is shown, and areas already downloaded are drawn on the map. Can be turned off on the Customization screen.

patches_added.name: Black theme
patches_added.description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.

patches_added.name: Blue pin
patches_added.description: Chromium-coloured flat map pin on every in-app product logo and the search bar's leading icon.

patches_added.name: Bypass Play Services checks
patches_added.description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks. Where Play services rejects the re-signed app, Maps degrades instead of crashing. Also skips Google's "isn't Play Protect certified" page, and with no Play services at all uses Android's own Cronet so the map still loads.

patches_added.name: Change app name
patches_added.description: Sets the launcher and app-switcher name, with a choice of launcher icon styles on light or dark backgrounds.

patches_added.name: Change package name
patches_added.description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name. On by default, because stock Maps comes built into most phones and cannot be replaced by a patched copy.

patches_added.name: Customization screen
patches_added.description: Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.

patches_added.name: Flock cameras
patches_added.description: Puts Flock and other license plate reader cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap -- the cameras DeFlock's volunteers map -- and chimes and shows a note when one is coming up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the ones near you from an OpenStreetMap server, over the same area as the speed cameras.

patches_added.name: Follow playing media
patches_added.description: Navigation's media controls show what an app is playing, also apps that refuse Maps such as Pocket Casts and TIDAL. Needs notification access (Customization), not on root mount installs.

patches_added.name: Hide ads and clutter
patches_added.description: Hides promoted map pins (on the map, in search results and along a route) and "Sponsored" search results, Gemini's AI summaries ("Know before you go" and the review summary), the row of businesses under an address on its place sheet, the home tab's Explore feed and the Explore / Contribute / You tabs. Each can be switched back on on the Customization screen.

patches_added.name: Legacy icon
patches_added.description: Uses the flat multicolour pin Maps had before the 2025 gradient icon as the launcher icon and on the screen Maps opens with. With Add microG-RE support, microG's C sits in the pin's circle.

patches_added.name: Location provider toggle
patches_added.description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, microG-RE's or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, neither is ever asked for a location. A source that is missing or disabled is never used, so location keeps working without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.

patches_added.name: Native navigation for Gearslip and Android Auto
patches_added.description: Shows this patched Maps app's live native map with app-owned car UI and standard navigation controls that Android Auto and compatible hosts can arrange.

patches_added.name: Offline saved places
patches_added.description: Save places without a Google account, kept only on the phone: Save opens Maps' own "Place saved" sheet (Want to go, Travel plans, Starred places, Favorites, your own lists, a note), and a "Local saved" row on the account sheet rebuilds Maps' You tab -- your recent places, your lists and labels (Home, Work, your own) -- with export and import (backup file, KML, Google Takeout's saved lists and Saved Places.json, several files or the whole Takeout .zip at once). It also has a Timeline: where the phone has been, grouped into days and visits, kept only on the phone, with GPX export. Recording is off until switched on there; it shows a notification while it runs. With Add microG-RE support, Maps' own Save keeps syncing to your account and Local saved instead copies the account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account).

patches_added.name: Power saving mode
patches_added.description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.

patches_added.name: Proxy
patches_added.description: Adds a Proxy screen to Customization that sends Maps' own traffic, map data included, through an HTTP proxy -- for example Orbot's (127.0.0.1:8118) to use Tor. Map data never falls back to a direct connection: if the proxy stops, Maps stops loading. Needs a recent Play services network engine (Cronet); Maps warns when it cannot take the proxy.

patches_added.name: Rectangle shapes
patches_added.description: Squares off rounded corners across the UI, including the two round navigation buttons.

patches_added.name: Remove permissions
patches_added.description: Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advertising ID, push messages and Google services settings. Left out with Add microG-RE support, whose account features need them.

patches_added.name: Remove sign-in prompts
patches_added.description: Removes Google's sign-in prompts: the first-launch "Make it your map" page, the search screen's "Tired of typing?" card and the account sheet's "Sign in" pill. Tapping "Your profile" (or the pill, where it still shows) answers with a "Can't sign in" toast instead of nothing. With Add microG-RE support, which signs in, only the first-launch page and the card go.

patches_added.name: Remove telemetry
patches_added.description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services. With Add microG-RE support, Firebase Installations and Location History are left alone, so Timeline, account sync and push messages keep working.

patches_added.name: Speed cameras
patches_added.description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server -- an area you choose there, about 25 to 175 km across.

patches_added.name: Speeding chime
patches_added.description: Plays a chime when your speed passes the speed limit during navigation, as Waze does. Maps itself only turns its speedometer red. When it chimes is chosen in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet.

patches_added.name: Trim account menu
patches_added.description: Removes Your Timeline, Location sharing, Your data in Maps and Help & feedback from the account sheet. Left out with Add microG-RE support, whose account features need them.

patches_added.name: Use the system voice for navigation
patches_added.description: Uses the phone's selected text-to-speech engine for Maps navigation instead of requiring Google TTS. Select DriveDeck in Android's text-to-speech settings to hear Maps with the local DriveDeck voice. If no system engine is ready, Maps keeps its original voice.

patches_added.name: Waze alerts
patches_added.description: Shows nearby Waze and Flitsmeister alerts as map pins with ahead-of-you chimes and notes. Supports our navigation broadcasts for current speed, speed limits and average-speed zones, plus bearinmind's Waze Share alerts with Maps feed. Choose a provider in Waze & external data source; external data is off by default. Updated patched providers start silently and are monitored while Maps is in use. Complete provider setup and location permissions once.

patches_added.name: Zoom controls in navigation
patches_added.description: Adds +, − and reset tiles during turn-by-turn that change the navigation zoom while the camera keeps following the car.

patches_removed.name: Experimental projected CAR two-wheeler routing
patches_removed.description: 26.44.06.1006895251 only. Experimental route selector and builder; AA bridge and live reroute unverified.

patches_added.name: Add microG-RE support
patches_added.description: Signs in to your Google account through microG-RE (MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore), keeping the name from Change app name. Not for root installs; for original microG, use Add original microG support.

patches_added.name: Allow any travel mode on Android Auto
patches_added.description: 26.44.06.1006895251 only. Android Auto no longer refuses navigation for its travel mode: driving routes navigate as driving and two-wheeler routes as two-wheeler, without "switch to ... directions".

patches_added.name: Always two-wheeler on Android Auto
patches_added.description: 26.44.06.1006895251 only. Android Auto treats two-wheeler (motorcycle) as its supported mode, so destinations searched on the head unit default to two-wheeler routes. Use with "Allow any travel mode on Android Auto" so driving routes are still accepted.

patches_added.description: 26.44.06.1006895251 only. Stops a re-signed Maps from crashing when Android Auto rejects its private car-service call ("Wrong signature"). Needed for native navigation on Android Auto.

patches_removed.name: Experimental projected CAR two-wheeler routing
patches_removed.description: 26.44.06.1006895251 only. Experimental route selector and builder; AA bridge and live reroute unverified.

patches_added.name: Clone install under another package name
patches_added.description: Installs a second copy of Facebook beside the first under its own package name and app name, for a phone where Facebook came preinstalled and a patched one won't install over it. Hushfacebook settings open in the copy the same way. It isn't selected by default because push notifications may not reach the copy, and you only need it for a second Facebook. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Share, Save or speaker button, or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also keep the Reels tab to accounts you follow, open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, do the same for a reel you open from a link or a chat, play a feed video again right there when you tap Watch again instead of opening Reels, play a video you tap in Saved in the video player instead of Reels, take the UP NEXT bar off the bottom of a video you open from the feed, hide the Fullscreen button under a wide video, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them, and hide the one-tap Subscribe button some authors get instead of Follow, or Search and the button beside it at the top of a video you open and of the Reels tab, and show when a reel or video was posted. Its Burn-in guard can fade a reel's buttons, caption and bars when you leave them alone, so they don't burn into the screen. With Turn off HDR brightness patched too, it can show Reels in gray, video and all. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.
